fields.value: Replication archive Peeters, Salaga and Juravich (2020) Management Science

dsDescriptionValue.value: This record contains the replication archive for the paper "Matching and Winning? The Impact of Upper and Middle Managers on Firm Performance in Major League Baseball" by Thomas Peeters, Steven Salaga and Matthew Juravich, which appeared in Management Science in 2020. Please read the Readme file first for empirical procedures.

fields.value:
This entry is a fifty-seven-file data package totaling 151.1 MB, containing files in .xml, .dta, .m, .do, .pdf and .csv formats.

If you use this dataset, please cite: Peeters, Thomas; Salaga, Steven; Juravich, matthew (2021). Replication archive Peeters, Salaga and Juravich (2020) Management Science. Erasmus University Rotterdam (EUR). Dataset. https://doi.org/10.25397/eur.13636682
